image_description: An open vintage comic book or graphic novel spread, displaying two pages of sequential art. The pages feature hand-drawn illustrations in a classic mid-20th-century style with muted, aged colors (yellows, reds, blues). The layout consists of multiple rectangular panels containing characters in suits and period clothing, along with speech bubbles and caption boxes filled with legible text. The paper appears slightly yellowed and textured, indicating age.

This is a common AI artifact in text-heavy generations.

The texture of the paper is uniformly smooth with a slight digital noise pattern rather than the specific grain of aged newsprint or glossy stock. Ink lines show slight bleeding or softness inconsistent with sharp offset printing.
Some panel borders warp slightly as they approach the central gutter, suggesting a minor failure in maintaining rigid geometric perspective across the curved page surface.
